next.name: cat
tip: Show the contents of the specified credentials.

next.name: decrypt
tip: Decrypt a ciphertext credential file into a plaintext credential file.

next.name: encrypt
tip: Encrypt a plaintext credential file into a ciphertext credential file.

next.name: list
tip: Show the list of passed credentials.

next.name: setup
tip: Generate the credentials host key if it does not exist yet.

option.name: --allow-null
tip: Allow decrypting credentials with an empty key.

option.name: --help
tip: Show this help.

option.name: --json
tip: Generate JSON output.
Possible values: pretty, short, off

option.name: --name
tip: Override the filename included in the encrypted credential.

option.name: --newline
tip: Suffix the output with a newline.
Possible values: auto, yes, no

option.name: --no-legend
tip: Do not show the headers and footers.

option.name: --no-pager
tip: Do not pipe output into a pager.

option.name: --not-after
tip: Include the specified invalidation time in the encrypted credential.

option.name: --pretty
tip: Output as a SetCredentialEncrypted= line.

option.name: --system
tip: Show credentials passed to the system.

option.name: --timestamp
tip: Include the specified timestamp in the encrypted credential.

option.name: --tpm2-device
tip: Pick the TPM2 device.

option.name: --tpm2-pcrs
tip: Specify TPM2 PCRs to seal against (fixed hash).

option.name: --tpm2-public-key
tip: Specify a PEM certificate to seal against.

option.name: --tpm2-public-key-pcrs
tip: Specify TPM2 PCRs to seal against (public key).

option.name: --tpm2-signature
tip: Specify the signature for the public key PCR policy.

option.name: --transcode
tip: Transcode the credential data.
Possible values: base64, unbase64, hex, unhex

option.name: --uid
tip: Select the user for scoped credentials.

option.name: --user
tip: Select user-scoped credential encryption.

option.name: --version
tip: Show package version.

option.name: --with-key
tip: Select the keys to encrypt with.
Possible values: host, tpm2, host+tpm2, null, auto, auto-initrd

option.name: -H
tip: Shortcut for --with-key=host.

option.name: -T
tip: Shortcut for --with-key=tpm2.
